what_it_does: One 97 Communications operates an AI-powered omni-channel payment and financial services platform for consumers and merchants. It facilitates digital payments, loan distribution, wealth management, and marketing services in India and select international markets.

segments.name: Payment Services
segments.comment: Includes payment processing, Soundbox, POS, online gateway, and subscription revenue.

segments.name: Distribution of Financial Services
segments.comment: Fastest-growing segment comprising merchant and consumer loan distribution, wealth, and insurance.

segments.name: Marketing Services
segments.comment: Advertising, travel ticketing, credit card distribution, and deals and gift vouchers.

scale: Average of 47,826 active on-roll employees in FY 2026
Subscription merchant base crossed 1.51 crore merchants
Over 4.5 crore merchants joined the digital economy through QR solutions
Average monthly transacting users expanded to 7.7 crore by Q4 FY 2026
risks: Macroeconomic conditions affecting customers and merchants
Pace of technology innovation and failure to maintain infrastructure
Cybersecurity threats, data breaches, and digital fraud
Fast-evolving regulatory landscape and statutory compliance requirements
geography: Domestic operations across India with emerging presence in select international markets.
